standard_prerequisites.name: The regular-model situation, minimality with coprime multiplicities, and vanishing of higher cohomology on the special fibre
standard_prerequisites.statement: The situation fixes a discrete valuation ring, a smooth projective curve over its fraction field, a regular proper model and the irreducible components of the special fibre with their multiplicities; minimality of the model is equivalent to minimality of the numerical type, and the hypothesis that the multiplicities have greatest common divisor one is what makes the reduction of the special fibre differ from the fibre only when some multiplicity exceeds one. Cohomology of coherent sheaves on the special fibre vanishes in degrees at least two, so a surjection of sheaves induces a surjection on first cohomology. The author's own lemmas of the chapter and the quoted vanishing proposition are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is one half of the genus formula of the section: it bounds the difference between the genus of the special fibre and that of its reduction from one side, the companion lemma giving the other side.

core_obligations: Surjectivity of first cohomology for surjections of sheaves: since cohomology of coherent sheaves on the special fibre vanishes in degrees at least two, any surjection of abelian sheaves on the fibre induces a surjection on first cohomology (source line 5386).

Filter the special fibre: the chapter provides a chain from the reduction of the fibre up to the fibre itself, each step adding one component; injectivity of the maps on global sections into the field of constants of the reduction shows that every member of the chain has global sections the residue field, hence the map on first cohomology from the fibre to the second-largest member is surjective (source lines 5387-5399).

Isolate the last step: writing the fibre as that member plus one component and restricting the sheaf attached to the negative of the member to that component gives an invertible sheaf on it, and the standard short exact sequence of coherent sheaves on the fibre yields a short exact sequence of first cohomology groups whose kernel is the first cohomology of that invertible sheaf (source lines 5399-5415).

Conclude both assertions: the degree of that invertible sheaf over the residue field is computed and shown to force its first cohomology to vanish exactly when the component contributes nothing, so the kernel is nontrivial precisely when the reduction differs from the fibre (source lines 5415-5429).

proof_roadmap.step: Surjections of sheaves induce surjections on first cohomology by the vanishing in higher degrees.
The chain from the reduction to the fibre and the surjectivity onto the second-largest member, via global sections.
The short exact sequence isolating one component and its kernel as the first cohomology of an invertible sheaf.
The degree computation for that sheaf, giving nontriviality of the kernel when the reduction differs from the fibre.
